In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a '''CR90 corvette''' was assigned to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces attached to [[Eyrie Base]]. The [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] participated in an attack on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Supply carrier/Legends|supply carrier]], as well as the rescue of [[Stevan Makintay]] from Imperial captivity.
